parsed.rationale: All five members are type-alias-object declarations with empty fields_or_signature lists, meaning the structural signal is purely that they are all empty type aliases — not that they alias the same underlying type or serve the same domain purpose. 'Discogs.Release.Label', 'Discogs.Release.ReleaseArtist', and 'Discogs.Master.ReleaseArtist' in Shared/Artwork/Sources/Artwork/DiscogsArtworkService.swift are Discogs API response shape aliases, while 'Release' (Shared/Metadata/Sources/Metadata/_Plant_ReleaseRepository.swift) and 'Artist' (Shared/Metadata/Sources/Metadata/_Plant_ArtistRepository.swift) in the Metadata package are domain-model aliases — these are structurally coincident empty aliases but encode entirely unrelated domain concepts across two different packages. Consolidating them would conflate Discogs API plumbing with the Metadata domain model, which is architecturally harmful. The shared_field_count of 2 with null jaccard and null shared_ancestor further confirms there is no meaningful shared shape beyond both being empty alias declarations.
